bear_case.summary: Booking is a high-quality compounder, but its growth is increasingly balance-sheet-heavy merchant revenue (+15% YoY) while agency revenue shrinks (-7% YoY in Q2 2026). Debt rose about $1.4B in H1 2026 to ~$20.2B. Its travel demand is exposed to a late-cycle consumer (+29k payrolls, the Fed hiking). The stock is down 28.5% from its high, and the screen's P/E could be flattered by Q2 2026 net income that more than doubled YoY (cause not isolated).

risks.risk: Consumer/travel demand slowdown in a hiking-Fed, weak-labor regime
risks.evidence: Regime memo: Sept NFP +29k, FOMC hike to 3.75-4.00%, XLY -6.9% 3M
risks.early_warning_signal: Room-night growth deceleration in Q3 print 2026-11-04; Q4 guide

risks.risk: Merchant mix shift lowers margins and adds working-capital and FX risk
risks.evidence: Merchant revenue +15% vs agency -7% YoY Q2 2026
risks.early_warning_signal: Merchant share of revenue; payment/processing costs as % of revenue

risks.risk: Rising leverage while rates are high
risks.evidence: LTD noncurrent 18.18B plus current 2.0B at 6/30/26 vs 16.86B plus 1.88B at 12/31/25
risks.early_warning_signal: New issuance coupons; current maturities of 2.0B within 12 months

risks.risk: Disintermediation by AI agents/Google, plus EU DMA gatekeeper regulation
risks.early_warning_signal: Share of direct/unpaid traffic; regulatory actions (UNAVAILABLE this run)

risks.risk: Earnings quality: Q2 2026 net income 1.95B vs 0.895B YoY on revenue +8%
risks.evidence: Gap likely driven by non-operating items (cause UNAVAILABLE)
risks.likelihood: Medium that the screen P/E overstates run-rate

accounting_red_flags.sbc_share_of_fcf: SBC 281M vs OCF 6.93B in H1 2026 (~4% of OCF; capex UNAVAILABLE)
accounting_red_flags.one_time_items: NI growth far outpaces revenue growth; driver UNAVAILABLE

value_trap: P/E of 17.5 may reflect peak travel demand and inflated GAAP earnings. The multiple can de-rate further if room nights slow and the merchant mix compresses take-rates.
